_note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every BRG shortcode. The docs (SHORTCODES.md, docs/shortcode-index.html) are GENERATED from this by kit/build.py — edit here, then run `python3 kit/build.py`. Pattern borrowed from fc-brands (temper/kit). Each component gets a `version` (int) + `contract` (hash of shortcode+type+attr names/defaults), stamped by the builder.

globals.name: ttl
globals.doc: Server cache seconds on any shortcode. ttl="0" = always fresh (test pages).

globals.name: ?brg_refresh=1
globals.doc: URL param (not an attr) — forces every BRG shortcode on the page to re-fetch once.

components.summary: A whole page fragment (v2.0 monolith) + shared header/footer.
components.aliases: brg_home, brg_our-restaurants, brg_team, brg_community, brg_careers (from pages.json)

attrs.name: ttl
attrs.doc: Server cache seconds. ttl="0" = always fresh.

attrs.name: chrome
attrs.doc: chrome="0" renders the page bare — no shared header/footer.

attrs.doc: Which page fragment (generic form of the aliases).

attrs.doc: Server cache seconds.

components.summary: WordPress-menu-driven nav (fixed). Content from Appearance → Menus.

attrs.name: layout
attrs.doc: center = logo centered; compact = logo-left, overflow → More drawer.

attrs.name: left
attrs.doc: Items per side (split/center) or total-before-overflow (compact).

attrs.name: right
attrs.doc: Items on the right side (split/center).

attrs.name: sticky
attrs.doc: pin stays; hide = hide-on-scroll-down (nav is fixed, so it always sticks).

attrs.name: bg
attrs.doc: solid (white bar, reserves space) · none (transparent, floats over hero) · frost (dark frosted glass + blur).

attrs.name: bgcolor
attrs.doc: Background color for solid/frost, any CSS color (bgcolor="#131210").

attrs.name: opacity
attrs.doc: Background opacity 0–1 (solid/frost).
